d6-control.used_for: the control pass of the D6 test

d6-science.used_for: the science between the variants of the D6 test

slots.used_for: the two analysis slots of a lot

note: the D6 of Amendment 4, item 15 (D6 proposal revision 4)
result_rule: PASS only with the six conditions of a valid conclusion and no difference in check 2; FAIL on any scientific difference, a control that does not report what it should, or a record with status error; INCOMPLETE on a missing analysis, an execution invalidated by check 1, an external interruption, or an input that does not match its hash (redone from the start, in full).

selection.rule:
The declared rule, applied to the generation parameters of an accepted manifest of
the ``determinism`` population (never to analysis results), in this order until ``n``
distinct cases: the mechanisms that diverged in the v1 generations (two cases each);
one case per class, noise model and mechanism; per class with a transit, the cases with
the expected-SNR ratio r just above and just below 1.0 and 1.5; the two masked-variability
cases with the smallest margin to a commensurate ratio; then the remaining cases by id.
